package_name: OT - GEMS - Impair Process Control Pack (MITRE)
description: Official MITRE CALDERA for OT GEMS abilities for validating behaviors that alter, degrade, or interfere with industrial process control. Provides 20 Morgana Scripts for ATT&CK for ICS Impair Process Control with verified protocol assets where required; CALDERA is not required at runtime.
author: MITRE (converted by X3M.AI for Morgana)
prerequisites: Morgana agent installed on an explicitly authorized execution host
Required OT facts supplied as Morgana tag values; no target defaults are provided
Required assets downloaded from Camelot and verified by SHA256
capabilities: Provides official MITRE CALDERA for OT GEMS behaviors for ATT&CK for ICS Impair Process Control.
Exercises behaviors that alter, degrade, or interfere with industrial process control against an operator-supplied GEMS simulator, lab, or approved target.
Uses verified package assets and protocol-specific parameters where required (3 unique assets in this pack).
use_cases: Validate GEMS monitoring, industrial telemetry, and ATT&CK for ICS detection coverage.
Run focused Impair Process Control exercises in an isolated OT lab or cyber range.
Assess whether defensive controls distinguish read-only protocol activity from process-changing behavior.
safety_notes: Highest operational risk in this pack: MODIFY. Review the risk badge on every Script before execution.
No target values are supplied; configure only an explicitly authorized lab, simulation, or approved production exercise.
Verified assets are downloaded only when a Script is explicitly executed; importing the pack never contacts an OT target.

tag_categories.label: GEMS Impair Process Control Parameters
tag_categories.description: Operator-supplied OT connection, read, process-write, and control values.
